title: Raise default_statistics_target to sharpen GetUserTweets selectivity estimates
configuration_cause: default_statistics_target=100 leaves coarse MCV/histogram resolution for the skewed user_id predicate driving GetUserTweets; the dominant transaction (88% of terminal capacity, p50 171us, p95 398us) is index-scan bound and its plan quality depends on selectivity estimates that 100 buckets resolve poorly.
mechanism: GetUserTweets consumes 88% of finite client terminal time, so any per-call reduction in pages touched directly raises completed-transaction goodput. With default_statistics_target=100 the planner's histogram for the skewed user_id column is coarse, biasing row estimates and index-vs-bitmap path choice. Raising the target to 400 quadruples histogram/MCV resolution for that predicate, tightening estimated_rows and favoring the cheaper cached index path, lowering per-call latency and freeing terminal capacity. This is a planner-statistics mechanism, orthogonal to the refuted WAL commit-path bundle; it does not touch WAL, buffers, or predicate locks.
query_effect: Finer user_id statistics let the planner pick the lower-cost index path for GetUserTweets, reducing pages per call and per-call latency.
expected_tps_effect: Modest increase in successful_transaction_tps as GetUserTweets terminal occupancy falls.
expected_latency_effect: GetUserTweets p50/p95 decrease; other transaction classes roughly unchanged.

predictions.rationale: Finer selectivity estimates reduce pages per GetUserTweets call, lowering median latency.
Better plan choice reduces tail pages touched for skewed users.
Lower GetUserTweets terminal occupancy frees capacity for more completed transactions.

alternatives.statement: If GetUserTweets latency is dominated by WAL sync queueing rather than plan quality, statistics changes will not move p50 and only WAL-path knobs would help.
If the dominant cost is physical page reads not resolved by estimates, blks_read per txn stays flat and a buffer/cache mechanism is required instead.

why_exceeds_incumbent: Targets the dominant 88%-terminal-capacity transaction via planner statistics, a mechanism class not yet tested and orthogonal to the refuted WAL bundle; a 2% GetUserTweets latency reduction frees enough terminal capacity for a measurable goodput gain.

knob_changes.numerical_basis: Quadruple from 100 to 400 within safe [50,500]; 4x histogram/MCV resolution for skewed user_id while keeping ANALYZE cost bounded.
knob_changes.mechanism_role: column statistics resolution for skewed predicate selectivity

nodes.label: Finer user_id selectivity estimates reduce GetUserTweets pages per call

cross_domain_requirements: ANALYZE must run after the change for new statistics to take effect; executor should trigger ANALYZE on tweets/user tables.
